prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on what you need (brand strategy, creative advertising, SEO/PPC, B2B lead gen, web/app product design), your industry, budget, and KPIs.

If you want a quick starting point:
- Barkley — a large, award‑winning full‑service creative & advertising agency based in KC (good for brand, national campaigns, creative).
- VML (part of VMLY&R) — global digital and experience agency with strong capabilities in digital strategy and large enterprise work, with KC roots.
- Plus many strong boutique digital, SEO, and performance shops in KC that may be a better fit for smaller budgets or niche needs.

How I can help next (pick one):
- Tell me your primary goal (e.g., increase leads, launch a brand, build an e‑commerce site), budget range, and timeline and I’ll recommend a tailored shortlist of agencies in KC.
- Or I can give a checklist and 10 questions to ask agencies to evaluate fit.

If you want to evaluate on your own, here’s a quick checklist:
1. Define goals and KPIs up front.
2. Look for relevant case studies (same industry or objective).
3. Check size & team expertise (in‑house vs. subcontractors).
4. Ask about process, reporting cadences, and tools.
5. Request references and measurable results.
6. Align on budget, timeline, and a pilot/project scope.

Which services are you looking for and what’s your budget/timeline? I’ll shortlist 3 agencies in KC that match.
